london.dataset: The London Register of Subsurface CO2 Storage
london.methodology: Pivot sheet selected by Imperial for the public register; annual MtCO2 values. Some years are averages derived from cumulative disclosures. Not audited financial data.

iea.citation: IEA, CCUS Projects Database, IEA, Paris, https://www.iea.org/data-and-statistics/data-product/ccus-projects-database
iea.scope: Capture, transport, storage and utilisation projects with a clear emissions-reduction scope; excludes low-climate-benefit utilisation, conventional internal urea use, and naturally occurring CO2 used for EOR.

ingestion.workbook_note: Project announcements are current to February 2026; workbook released 27 March 2026.

gccsi.structured_scope: The report's complete 47-facility in-construction appendix only.
gccsi.country_scope_limitation: GSR 2025 does not reproduce GSR 2024's all-stage country facilities table. The dashboard therefore labels its all-stage country layer GSR 2024 and its global/construction baseline GSR 2025; the vintages are never blended into one total.
gccsi.methodology: PDF table located by repeated column headings; capture capacities preserved as Mtpa; T&S rows remain blank.

baseline_comparison.comparison_status: official workbook ingested; exact matches separated from rule-assisted review candidates
baseline_comparison.likely_naming_or_scope_differences: The authenticated workbook enables name-level review. 21 additional same-country rule-assisted naming candidates are listed separately and are not counted as matches until human adjudication; component/phase naming and differing source cut-off dates remain material.
